name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through a chance encounter restoring a vintage racing car for a local collector. His meticulous eye for detail and steady hand quickly translated into a passion for ensuring flawless paint finishes. He spent years honing his skills in smaller outfits, tackling everything from custom liveries to critical repairs after track incidents. Jean-Pierre is known for his relentless pursuit of perfection, ensuring every panel reflects the highest standards. He believes a perfect paint job isn't just aesthetic; it's a reflection of the team's dedication to excellence.

His demanding nature stems from a deep-seated belief that cutting corners is never an option. Jean-Pierre approaches each project with a methodical precision, meticulously planning every step to minimize errors and maximize efficiency. While his bluntness might ruffle feathers at times, his colleagues respect his unwavering commitment and the quality of his work. He's a master of color matching and blending, capable of recreating almost any shade with pinpoint accuracy. He prefers working alone, focusing intently on the task at hand.

physical.description: A burly man with a focused gaze, Jean-Pierre always wears a clean, white shop coat.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a needle point before starting any work.
Insists on playing classical music (loudly) while working.
Has a collection of miniature paint sprayers he keeps meticulously cleaned.
